rows.text: Sidewalls must flex under load and absorb irregularities; they are not rigid.
evidence: Michelin, Radial tyres, https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/by-technology/radial: tele radiali a 90 gradi, tele diagonali incrociate e fianchi radiali flessibili.

rows.text: In a cross-ply carcass, the cords in the layers run diagonally and cross each other.
evidence: Michelin, Radial tyres, https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/by-technology/radial: tele radiali a 90 gradi, tele diagonali incrociate e fianchi radiali flessibili.

rows.text: In a radial tire the carcass cords run from bead to bead, roughly at right angles to the direction of travel.
evidence: Michelin, Radial tyres, https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/by-technology/radial: tele radiali a 90 gradi, tele diagonali incrociate e fianchi radiali flessibili.

rows.text: The distinction depends on carcass cord orientation: radial or diagonal and crossed.
evidence: Michelin, Radial tyres, https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/by-technology/radial: tele radiali a 90 gradi, tele diagonali incrociate e fianchi radiali flessibili.

rows.text: The radial carcass lets the sidewalls flex more readily than cross-ply construction.
evidence: Michelin, Radial tyres, https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/by-technology/radial: tele radiali a 90 gradi, tele diagonali incrociate e fianchi radiali flessibili.

rows.text: In a bend the radial belt stabilizes the tread; cross-ply construction can deform more and lose some road contact.
evidence: Continental, Tire Construction, OTR Technical Data Book, p. 19, https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/pl/download-/cst/Continental_Technical_Data_Book_OTR_Tires_24.01.2020-12.01.28.pdf.coredownload.pdf: cintura radiale stabilizza il battistrada e riduce la deformazione trasversale dell’impronta; The Contact Patch, https://www.thecontactpatch.com/road/c2019-the-contact-patch: in forti curve il bordo di una diagonale può sollevarsi riducendo contatto.

rows.text: The construction types are radial and cross-ply; “staggered plies” does not describe a carcass type here.
evidence: Michelin, Radial tyres, https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/by-technology/radial: tele radiali a 90 gradi, tele diagonali incrociate e fianchi radiali flessibili.

rows.text: Carcass construction is classified as radial or cross-ply, not longitudinal.
evidence: Michelin, Radial tyres, https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/by-technology/radial: tele radiali a 90 gradi, tele diagonali incrociate e fianchi radiali flessibili.

rows.text: The distinction concerns the arrangement of carcass cords, not the number or material of the plies.
evidence: Michelin, Radial tyres, https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/by-technology/radial: tele radiali a 90 gradi, tele diagonali incrociate e fianchi radiali flessibili.

rows.text: In a bend the belt stabilizes a radial tread; a cross-ply tread can deform and lose some contact rather than generally retaining more.
evidence: Continental, Tire Construction, OTR Technical Data Book, p. 19, https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/pl/download-/cst/Continental_Technical_Data_Book_OTR_Tires_24.01.2020-12.01.28.pdf.coredownload.pdf: cintura radiale stabilizza il battistrada e riduce la deformazione trasversale dell’impronta; The Contact Patch, https://www.thecontactpatch.com/road/c2019-the-contact-patch: in forti curve il bordo di una diagonale può sollevarsi riducendo contatto.

rows.text: The reverse is true: radial sidewalls are generally more flexible than cross-ply sidewalls.
evidence: Michelin, Radial tyres, https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/by-technology/radial: tele radiali a 90 gradi, tele diagonali incrociate e fianchi radiali flessibili.

rows.text: The tread touches the road: its compound and pattern contribute to grip.
evidence: Continental, Tire tread, https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/tire-tread/: contatto con strada, disegni e indicatori nei solchi principali.

rows.text: Grooves channel water away from the contact area, helping the tire maintain grip on wet roads.
evidence: Continental, Tire damages, https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/tire-damages/: tasselli si deformano e si comprimono durante il rotolamento; intagli drenano acqua.

rows.text: Wear indicators are small raised bars in the main grooves: they signal wear when the tread reaches their level.
evidence: Continental, Tire tread, https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/tire-tread/: contatto con strada, disegni e indicatori nei solchi principali.

rows.text: Compound flexibility changes with temperature: some compounds become stiffer in the cold.
evidence: Continental, Tire types, https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/tire-types/: la gomma estiva diventa meno flessibile a basse temperature.

rows.text: Manufacturers and tire types use different patterns to balance grip, wear and noise.
evidence: Continental, Tire tread, https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/tire-tread/: contatto con strada, disegni e indicatori nei solchi principali.

rows.text: Front and rear axle patterns may differ, provided the tires suit their positions and the vehicle.
evidence: Michelin, How should you choose your truck, bus or coach tyres?, https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/help-advice/truck/truck-bus-tyre-marking-and-basics: disegni F/Z per asse sterzante e D/Z per motore, con requisiti di montaggio.

rows.text: The quiz marks this VERO, but 1.6 mm over the whole surface is a more conservative condition, not the minimum required everywhere. For Italian autoveicoli (such as cars and trucks), trolleybuses and trailers, the rule requires at least 1.6 mm in the main grooves in the central zone covering approximately three quarters of the tread; the pattern must remain visible across the full width and circumference.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, appendice VIII art. 237, lett. a, https://www.provincia.pc.it/Allegati/Normativa/dpr495_921325687348.pdf — disegno visibile sull’intera larghezza e circonferenza; profondità minima 1,6 mm per autoveicoli, filoveicoli e rimorchi negli intagli principali della zona centrale di circa tre quarti. Il testo non prescrive una percentuale esatta dell’80% né 1,6 mm su tutta la superficie.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSO: the rule does not specify an exact 80% of the surface. For Italian autoveicoli (such as cars and trucks), trolleybuses and trailers it requires at least 1.6 mm in the main grooves in the central zone covering approximately three quarters of the tread. Coverage of 80% is not itself unlawful: all main grooves and pattern visibility must be checked.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, appendice VIII art. 237, lett. a, https://www.provincia.pc.it/Allegati/Normativa/dpr495_921325687348.pdf — disegno visibile sull’intera larghezza e circonferenza; profondità minima 1,6 mm per autoveicoli, filoveicoli e rimorchi negli intagli principali della zona centrale di circa tre quarti. Il testo non prescrive una percentuale esatta dell’80% né 1,6 mm su tutta la superficie.

rows.text: Radial and cross-ply describe carcass arrangement; they do not require the radial tread to be wider.
evidence: Michelin, Radial tyres, https://b2b.middle-east.michelin.com/by-technology/radial: tele radiali a 90 gradi, tele diagonali incrociate e fianchi radiali flessibili.

rows.text: Dual mounting does not remove tread requirements: on motor vehicles the main grooves must retain the prescribed minimum depth.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, appendice VIII art. 237, comma 1 lett. a, https://rivistagiuridica.aci.it/fileadmin/Documenti/regolamento_codice_della_strada.pdf: disegno visibile dove previsto, profondità degli intagli principali di autoveicoli, filoveicoli e rimorchi almeno 1,60 mm.

rows.text: Tread blocks are elastic: they deform and compress as they enter the contact patch, then regain their shape.
evidence: Continental, Tire damages, https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/tire-damages/: tasselli si deformano e si comprimono durante il rotolamento; intagli drenano acqua.

rows.text: The tread is a rubber compound; nylon may instead appear in reinforcement layers separate from the tread.
evidence: Continental, Tyre Basics, p. 12, https://www.continental-tires.com/content/dam/conti-tires-cms/continental/market-content/mx/tecnologia/download-tire-basics.pdf.coredownload.pdf: battistrada in gomma naturale e sintetica, tele di copertura in nylon separato.

rows.text: The tread must be able to deform: its compound balances grip and wear resistance rather than maximizing rigidity.
evidence: Continental, Tire damages, https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/tire-damages/: tasselli si deformano e si comprimono durante il rotolamento; intagli drenano acqua. Continental, Tire tread, https://www.continental-tires.com/tire-knowledge/tire-tread/: contatto con strada, disegni e indicatori nei solchi principali.

rows.text: There is no general 3 mm limit on block height: tread depth depends on the tire’s design and use.
evidence: Michelin, Tyre tread depth, https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/advice/tyre-basics/tyre-tread-depth: profondità progettata in funzione di durata e consumi; Michelin SUV tyres, https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/advice/suv-tyres-guide/suv-frequently-asked-questions/what-is-the-legal-limit-for-suv-tyres: battistrada nuovi normalmente 7–9 mm.
